metrics.label: Cosine similarity
metrics.measures: Direction similarity of the Reference and Target vectors

metrics.label: Cosine distance
metrics.measures: How far the Reference and Target directions are apart

metrics.label: Relative L2
metrics.measures: L2 error relative to the Reference L2 norm

metrics.label: Norm ratio
metrics.measures: Target L2 norm divided by the Reference L2 norm

metrics.label: RMSE
metrics.measures: Root mean square error across all elements
metrics.reading: 0: identical values; larger errors weigh more

metrics.label: Kullback–Leibler divergence
metrics.measures: Kullback–Leibler divergence from Reference to Target
metrics.formula: Σ p log(p / q), p Reference, q Target
metrics.inputs: Full captured vocabulary logits of the token; softmax (T=1), independent of the generation settings; no top-k, top-p or sampling constraints

metrics.label: Jensen–Shannon divergence
metrics.measures: Symmetric difference of the Reference and Target distributions
metrics.formula: ½ KL(p ‖ m) + ½ KL(q ‖ m), m = (p + q) / 2, base 2
metrics.inputs: Full captured vocabulary logits of the token; softmax (T=1), independent of the generation settings; no top-k, top-p or sampling constraints

metrics.label: Entropy
metrics.measures: Average information of one runtime’s distribution; fractional bits are valid
metrics.reading: 0 bits: one token has all the probability · 1 bit: two tokens of 50% each · higher: more spread across tokens

metrics.label: Selected probability
metrics.measures: Probability of the selected token in one runtime’s distribution
metrics.reading: 100%: the runtime was certain of its token

metrics.label: Top-2 margin
metrics.measures: Highest minus second-highest token probability of one runtime
metrics.reading: Higher: larger separation between the top two tokens

analyses.label: KV cache
analyses.inputs: Stored KV values of each position and KV head, compared over the batch and channel (head_dim) axes in float64; for two models of one KV architecture (one model in two runtimes), each side read through its own layout, an int8 side dequantized by the scale its model gives the cache

analyses.label: KV head
analyses.inputs: One KV head’s stored channels at one position, compared in float64; for two models, an int8 side dequantized by its model’s scale

analyses.label: Token Diff
analyses.inputs: The captured activations of the forward that produced the token, compared in float64

analyses.label: Final Logits
analyses.inputs: Raw captured final logits, before softmax; no centering

analyses.label: Sampling
analyses.inputs: The capture holds the logits before sampling, not the sampler’s probabilities: each runtime’s distribution is the softmax of its full captured vocabulary logits divided by its sampler temperature (1 when none is set), before top-k, top-p or any other constraint; a greedy sampler’s too. Each runtime uses its own temperature and selected token.

analyses.label: Intermediate tensors
analyses.inputs: Captured intermediate tensors of each position and sync point, compared in float64
